integrity: Analytic factorization proof is self-contained; exact rational finite examples are corroborative only. Source comparisons are best knowledge and not independent publication-priority certification.
limitations: Local pair theorem only; does not assert globally open convolution on infinite torsion groups, nor any property at pairs with two infinitely supported factors. Exact aperture orders, not optimal asymptotic constants.
title: Sharp local convolution openness on finite-support torsion strata
